# Static export - Apache configuration
# Default language: __DEFAULT_LANG__
# Generated by the static export tool. Safe to edit after upload.

Options -Indexes
DirectoryIndex index.html
ErrorDocument 404 /404.html
AddDefaultCharset UTF-8

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Default-language redirect (replicates middleware.ts)
# Paths without a language prefix go to /__DEFAULT_LANG__/<path>.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On

# "/" is served by index.html (meta refresh + JS redirect)
RewriteRule ^$ - [L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(fa|en|ar|tr|fr|de|es)(/|$)
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(_next|_data|media|uploads|fonts|fontawesome|webfonts|data)(/|$)
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(send\.php|static-shim\.js|sitemap\.xml|robots\.txt|404\.html)$
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(favicon|apple-touch-icon|android-chrome|site\.webmanifest)
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ /__DEFAULT_LANG__/$1 [R=302,L]
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Block direct web access to PHP internals (send.php stays reachable;
# it reads config.php from disk, which this rule does not affect).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<FilesMatch "^(config|lib)\.php$">
  <IfModule mod_authz_core.c>
    Require all denied
  </IfModule>
  <IfModule !mod_authz_core.c>
    Order allow,deny
    Deny from all
  </IfModule>
</FilesMatch>

<IfModule mod_alias.c>
RedirectMatch 403 ^/_ratelimit(/|$)
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MIME types
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_mime.c>
AddType video/mp4 .mp4
AddType video/webm .webm
AddType image/webp .webp
AddType image/avif .avif
AddType font/woff2 .woff2
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compression
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/css application/javascript text/javascript application/json image/svg+xml
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Caching
# Long: hashed assets, media, fonts. Short (5 min): HTML and _data JSON,
# which change with every export.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_setenvif.c>
SetEnvIf Request_URI "^/(_next/static|media|uploads|fonts|fontawesome|webfonts)/" LONG_CACHE
SetEnvIf Request_URI "^/_data/.*\.json$" SHORT_CACHE
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" env=LONG_CACHE
Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=300" env=SHORT_CACHE
<FilesMatch "\.html$">
  Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=300"
</FilesMatch>
Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_expires.c>
ExpiresActive On
ExpiresByType text/html "access plus 5 minutes"
ExpiresByType application/json "access plus 5 minutes"
ExpiresByType image/webp "access plus 1 year"
ExpiresByType image/avif "access plus 1 year"
ExpiresByType font/woff2 "access plus 1 year"
ExpiresByType video/mp4 "access plus 1 year"
ExpiresByType video/webm "access plus 1 year"
</IfModule>
